Bihar men prashasnik pherabdal ka silsila lagatar jari hai. purv mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke sarkari aapt sachiv pramod kumar ko bihar rajy bhandar nigam ke prabandh nideshak ka atirikt prabhar saunpa gaya hai.
Aakhir pramod kumar ko yah jimmedari kyon di gaee aur is phaisle ke kya mayne hain?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
